title: calamus unijugus
intro: Calamus unijugus, commonly known as Acorus unijugus, is a type of rhizomatous perennial plant native to China. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Calamus unijugus include expectorant and anti-spasmodic effects, making it useful in treating respiratory conditions and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
